title: Nakashima pounds Fritz, Bejlek beats Keys in Cincinnati upsets
desc: Brandon Nakashima continued his red-hot pace on Friday, knocking out sixth-seeded Taylor Fritz 7-6 (11/9), 4-6, 6-3 to reach the ATP-WTA Cincinnati Masters semi-finals.Unseeded Czech Sara Bejlek also advanced, backing up her stunning victory over world number one Aryna Sabalenka with a 3-6, 6-4, 7-6 (7/5) quarter-final win over Madison Keys.

Tooth count may predict survival after pancreatic cancer surgery
desc: Pancreatic cancer patients with at least 21 natural teeth survived nearly two years longer after surgery than those with fewer teeth in a study of 339 people. Researchers suspect tooth loss may reflect decades of inflammation, frailty, nutrition, and other factors tied to the body’s overall resilience.

title: An asteroid spent roughly 60 years quietly shadowing Earth's journey around the Sun before astronomers noticed it in 2025. Orbital calculations show 2025 PN7 has been locked in step with our planet si
desc: 2025 PN7 is a tiny Sun-orbiting quasi-satellite whose 60-year relationship with Earth comes from orbital modelling, while precovery images now trace its measured history to 2013.
